dex.entry: A stout, bumbling clown kin that carries its own water in a flower on its chest and squirts it at anything that looks too serious, including itself in mirrors. It honks a rubber horn instead of a cry. Fishers on the quay say a McClownface once put out a lamp by accident and has been apologising ever

art.silhouette: A plump, waddling kin with a big round body in baggy polka-dot overalls (sea-blue with white dots), a squirting daisy-flower on its chest dripping water, a fluffy tuft of curly hair in bright tide-blue, a large round red clown nose, a wide painted grin, enormous floppy shoes, and a little brass rubber-bulb horn held in one hand. A small splash of water droplets around the flower. At 64px it reads as a cheerful chunky seaside clown with a squirting flower.
